pairings.nmcName: Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education & Research, Kolkata

Same distinctive name (hyphen only). NMC address 'Sovapur, Bijra Road, Jaymua, Durgapur - Dist. Burdwan - 713206' shows Durgapur town in Burdwan district, reconciling the two location strings.

pairings.ourName: KPC Medical College and Hospital, Kolkata
pairings.evidence: Same distinctive name KPC; Jadavpur is a locality of Kolkata. Only KPC medical college in the state.

pairings.ourName: Maharaja Jitendra Narayan Medical College and Hospital, Cooch Behar
pairings.nmcName: Coochbehar Government Medical College & Hospital, Coochbehar, WB
pairings.evidence: Rename, not a second college: Coochbehar Government Medical College & Hospital was renamed Maharaja Jitendra Narayan Medical College & Hospital (MJNMCH). Confirmed by the college's own site https://www.mjnmch.ac.in/about-us and https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maharaja_Jitendra_Narayan_Medical_College_and_Hospital (both give est. 2019, 100 MBBS seats, matching the NMC row). NOTE: distinct from 'JMN Medical College, Nadia' (private, est. 2023) despite the near-anagram acronym.

NMC address is literally 'Medical College, Kolkata, 88, College Street Kolkata- 700073' and its website is medicalcollegekolkata.org — the NMC row is our college with a 'Govt.' prefix. 250 seats matches. This is the only Kolkata-city government college left unclaimed in the pool, so no ambiguity with other 'Government Medical College' records.
Same name, '& Hospitals' suffix only; same city.
